dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean the... the Snezhnaya Royal Railway Transport Bureau? It's in charge of just about everything related to the trains...

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: There are safety officers who keep them running safely, conductors like us who work onboard during the journey...

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: And detectives who deal with crimes... I-I actually wanted to be a detective at first, but they said I was too timid for the job. It was... well, it was pretty heartbreaking.
